sauti sol.bio: Africa's iconic multi-award winning Afro-pop band (Bien, Chimano, Savara, Polycarp). Celebrated for four-part acoustic vocal harmonies and historic pan-African anthems.

wakadinali.name: Wakadinali
wakadinali.bio: East Africa's foremost Hip-Hop & Drill powerhouse trio (Scar Mkadinali, Domani Munga, Sewersydaa). Known as 'Rong Rende', they redefine the authentic street voice of Nairobi.

mejja.name: Mejja (Okwonkwo)
mejja.bio: The undisputed King of Kenyan Genge storytelling. Famed for infectious humor, relatable street narratives, and iconic bottle-in-hand visuals.

bensoul.name: Bensoul
bensoul.bio: Multi-instrumentalist, bassist, soulful songwriter and producer. Renowned for raw emotion, melodic storytelling, and smooth East African Neo-Soul vibes.

nyashinski.name: Nyashinski
nyashinski.bio: Celebrated Kenyan music icon, former member of Kleptomaniax. Renowned for timeless conscious anthems, Afropop melodies, and razor-sharp lyricism.

khaligraph.name: Khaligraph Jones
khaligraph.bio: The OG. Soundcity MVP Best Hip Hop Act in Africa, AFRIMMA winner. East Africa's premier heavyweight rapper, songwriter, and producer.

burna boy.name: Burna Boy
burna boy.bio: Grammy Award-winning Nigerian singer, songwriter, and global stage powerhouse. Pioneer of Afro-Fusion combining dancehall, reggae, and Afrobeats.
